protocol.target: stored cursor velocity at reference + lag
protocol.eligibility_rule: Target samples are those leaving room for the largest candidate lag and a whole history before it, so every lag is scored on identical targets.
protocol.flattened_layout: bin-major: bin 0 units 0..n, then bin 1, and so on

not_built.validation: Built later, once the lag is selected from training data.
not_built.held_out: Not constructed before the frozen evaluation.
